# drip

> Free, open-source macOS CLI (MIT). drip shows a native card from your Mac's notch, or the top of a screen without one, when a command or coding agent finishes or needs you. It is not Notification Center, so it needs no Notifications permission. macOS 13+. Install: `brew install jrnxf/tap/drip`.
